Identify key drivers and significant regulatory or infrastructural barriers for AI adoption in India.
Evaluate the competitive landscape and primary business models gaining traction in the Indian AI ecosystem.
Determine the risks and ethical challenges facing the deployment of AI technologies within the Indian context.
